theorems.name: Submission.dph_hausdorff_product_formula
theorems.statement: (∀ (P m : ℕ) (N : Set (Eucl P)), (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) N = 0 → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))) {y | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ N} = 0) ∧ (∀ (P m : ℕ) (A : Set (Eucl P)), NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) → CountablyRectifiable m A → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (A ∩ K) < ∞) → ∀ g : Eucl (P + 1) → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → ∫⁻ y in {y | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ A}, g y ∂(μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))) = ∫⁻ s : ℝ, ∫⁻ x in A, g ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ x))) ∂(μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)))
